text.description_html:
First Impressions SD-SLAC2 2 Inch Modern Acrylic Shower Door Pulls

These 2" modern slimline acrylic shower door pulls are hand made in the USA by the master craftsmen at First Impressions from the finest clear acrylic available. The crystal clear acrylic is manufactured with UV inhibitors to prevent yellowing and fading.

Specifications for First Impressions SD-SLAC-2 Modern Shower Door Pull

  • Total Length: 2"
  • Acrylic Diameter: 5/8"
  • Pull Handle Material: Crystal Clear Acrylic
  • Pull Bracket Material: Solid Brass
  • Polished Nickel Finish

Packaged with 2 shower door pulls and includes the hardware for back to back mounting on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass shower doors.

*Sold as a Pair (2 Pulls)
